Privacy & cookies

How this website handles your information.

Updated 11 October 2026

Who we areEnquiries and downloaded briefsWhen you email usCookies and local storageHosting and external servicesQuestions and requestsUpdates

Who we are

Fusion Labs is a design and technology studio within Neurofusion Systems, based in Harare, Zimbabwe. For privacy questions, email info@fusionlabs.co.zw.

Enquiries and downloaded briefs

The enquiry form uses your name, email address, selected service, project details and any optional budget or timing you provide. It prepares a draft in your email app; it does not submit your details to a website database. Preparing a draft does not send an email. You choose whether to send it. Downloading a brief creates a text file on your device; copying an enquiry places its contents on your clipboard.

When you email us

Information you send by email is handled through email services and used to discuss your enquiry and any resulting project. Please avoid including passwords, payment card details or sensitive personal information in your initial enquiry. Ask us about the arrangements for sharing confidential project material.

Cookies and local storage

The current website code does not set cookies, use browser local storage, or include analytics or advertising trackers. Fonts, photographs and animation libraries are served with the website. Your browser or email app may retain form entries or drafts according to its own settings.

Hosting and external services

The hosting provider may process technical request information, such as your IP address and browser information, when delivering the website. Hosting log retention and provider details are not specified here; contact us for those details. External photo-credit links take you to Unsplash, whose own privacy practices apply. Your email provider handles drafts and messages according to its own terms. WhatsApp support links open WhatsApp in a new tab with a suggested greeting. The website does not send your form entries to WhatsApp. You choose whether to send the message; information you share there is handled through WhatsApp and used to respond to your support enquiry. WhatsApp's own privacy terms apply.

Questions and requests

Email us to ask about information you have sent, request a correction or deletion, or raise a privacy concern. Include enough detail to identify your enquiry, without sending sensitive identification documents unless requested through an agreed channel. Record retention and any applicable requirements will depend on the enquiry or service arrangement. For information about Zimbabwe's data protection authority, visit POTRAZ.

Updates

This notice describes the current website. Changes to the form, hosting or third-party integrations may require an updated notice. The date above identifies this version.
